polaris: Decide whether eta/P_oe is a leakage-free input-side odd/even bilayer phase-transfer residual or collapses to oxygen, strain, dephasing, orbital, and sample-quality baselines.
framework: Bilayer linear response in the normal state. The operational object is the static or low-energy integrated odd/even channel imbalance of a bilayer susceptibility that can be accessed by q_z-resolved magnetic/orbital spectroscopy and residualized against same-sample optical, structural, oxygen, and dephasing baselines.
findings: P_oe can be made mathematically well-defined and leakage-free only as a normal-state channel susceptibility ratio, not as a superconducting spin resonance, gap-derived quantity, or Tc-trained latent variable. The cleanest definition is P_oe(q,Omega,T,p) = (chi_odd - chi_even)/(chi_odd + chi_even), where chi_odd and chi_even are nonnegative spectral integrals of the same response channel over a preregistered normal-state energy window. Positive P_oe means odd interlayer transfer dominates; negative P_oe means even/intralayer-like response dominates; near chi_odd + chi_even = 0 the observable is undefined and must be censored rather than regularized into a readiness score. Existing La3Ni2O7 data provide components but not a same-sample full P_oe packet. The best existing reanalysis is ambient-pressure RIXS Fig. 2 and Fig. 4 of Chen et al. 2024 for L/polarization dependence of magnetic excitations and SDW intensity, combined only as a proof-of-extraction proxy, not as pressure-series validation. Oxygen/strain/dephasing covariance can annihilate the residual under realistic small-N pressure datasets unless the experiment uses same-sample repeated pressure points plus an intervention or matched-pair design that decorrelates P_oe from vacancy, strain, and linewidth baselines.
weakest_link: No published same-sample normal-state dataset was found that contains q_z-resolved odd/even bilayer susceptibility, c-axis optical/THz spectral weight and scattering rate, oxygen-vacancy maps, strain/structural phase fraction, and dz2/ligand-hole spectral weight on identical La3Ni2O7 specimens or pressure points.
next_plan: Round 3 should turn this into a go/no-go threshold table: minimum channel separability, pressure-point count, residual effect size, and covariance limits required before C_phi_ind can be called non-collapsing.
literature_needed: La3Ni2O7 pressure RIXS normal state q_z scan; La3Ni2O7 inelastic neutron scattering pressure normal state; La3Ni2O7 c-axis optical conductivity under pressure; high-pressure THz/infrared Drude spectral weight La3Ni2O7; same-sample STEM EELS oxygen vacancies Raman pressure La3Ni2O7; theory constrained bilayer susceptibility even odd channel normal state

chi_odd.operational_definition: chi_odd(q,Omega,T,p) = integral_{omega_min}^{omega_max} S_odd(q,omega,T,p) / omega d_omega, where S_odd is the antisymmetric bilayer response under layer exchange, extracted from q_z or polarization form factors in the normal state.
chi_odd.sign: Nonnegative by construction when extracted from a positive spectral density. Odd dominance means chi_odd > chi_even, not a negative susceptibility.
chi_odd.preferred_window: Use T above all superconducting output and above any output-reveal window; for La3Ni2O7 pressure work preregister T >= 120 K or T >= max(Tc_onset + 40 K, 120 K), with sensitivity checks at 150 K and 200 K. Avoid using spectra below Tc or superconducting-gap/resonance energies as labels.
allowed_raw_sources: inelastic neutron or RIXS intensity at q_z values where the bilayer odd form factor sin(q_z*d/2)**2 is large
polarization-resolved RIXS magnetic/orbital excitations fitted to a bilayer response model
normal-state Raman modes only as structural/strain covariates unless a calibrated layer-antisymmetric electronic Raman vertex exists
forbidden_sources: Tc, zero resistance, Meissner or diamagnetic volume
models trained to classify superconducting versus nonsuperconducting pressure points

chi_even.operational_definition: chi_even(q,Omega,T,p) = integral_{omega_min}^{omega_max} S_even(q,omega,T,p) / omega d_omega, where S_even is the symmetric bilayer response under layer exchange, extracted from the complementary q_z or polarization form factor in the same normal-state measurement.
chi_even.sign: Nonnegative by construction. Negative P_oe is allowed and means the even channel dominates.
chi_even.same_units_requirement: chi_even and chi_odd must be extracted from the same response channel, same energy window, same normalization, same sample, same pressure point, and same temperature protocol.

P_oe.sign_convention: P_oe > 0 means odd/interlayer antisymmetric bilayer response dominates. P_oe = 0 means no odd/even preference. P_oe < 0 means even/symmetric response dominates. Readiness, if used, is signed; abs(P_oe) is a separate anisotropy magnitude and must not be substituted silently.
P_oe.regularization_rule: Do not add epsilon to the denominator in the scientific definition. If chi_odd + chi_even <= denominator_floor, declare P_oe unidentifiable for that row. A plotting-only epsilon may be used but cannot enter inference.
P_oe.denominator_floor: denominator_floor = max(5*sigma_chi_sum, instrument_background_floor), preregistered before output reveal

singular_limits.expected: undefined; censor row, do not rank

singular_limits.case: chi_odd and chi_even both scaled by lambda > 0

eta.round2_definition: eta is the component of normal-state input response not spanned by baseline vector B_base after P_oe is extracted independently. If P_oe is not independently measurable, eta remains unidentified and collapses operationally.

primary_route.name: normal-state q_z-resolved RIXS or inelastic neutron odd/even extraction plus same-sample optical/structure baselines
primary_route.raw_observable: I(q_parallel,q_z,omega; polarization,T,p) in the normal state
extraction_steps: Measure the same crystal or film at multiple q_z values that weight cos(q_z*d/2)**2 and sin(q_z*d/2)**2 differently.
Fit chi_even(q,omega) and chi_odd(q,omega) with shared resolution, self-absorption, and background parameters.
Integrate each fitted spectral function over a preregistered normal-state window such as 20-120 meV for magnetic excitations, excluding elastic leakage and superconducting resonance/gap windows.
Compute P_oe and its uncertainty by bootstrap or posterior sampling.
On the same sample/pressure point, measure W_c, f_D, gamma, V_O, epsilon_strain, Z_dz2, and remove them by preregistered residualization.
primary_route.leakage_exclusion: The fit cannot use superconducting labels, pressure points chosen because they later become superconducting, gap magnitude, zero resistance, diamagnetism, or post-hoc Tc ranks.
primary_route.status: conceptually valid but not yet demonstrated as a same-sample pressure-series packet in La3Ni2O7

secondary_routes.use: Most practical near-term channel probe because La3Ni2O7 ambient-pressure RIXS already resolves magnetic excitations, SDW order, polarization dependence, and L dependence.
secondary_routes.limitation: Current ambient-pressure data do not provide a high-pressure normal-state odd/even pressure series, and pressure-cell RIXS is technically hard.

secondary_routes.use: Cleanest formal odd/even bilayer separation through q_z form factors, established in bilayer systems.
secondary_routes.limitation: Requires large high-quality crystals and high-pressure neutron feasibility; not currently a complete La3Ni2O7 pressure route.

secondary_routes.use: Good for structural phase fraction, Raman-active phonon renormalization, strain gradients, and pressure hydrostaticity covariates.
secondary_routes.limitation: Not sufficient by itself for chi_odd/chi_even unless a calibrated electronic Raman vertex with layer parity is established. Treat as baseline, not P_oe, in Round 2.

secondary_routes.use: Measures W_c, f_D, and gamma, the main c-axis coherence baselines to condition out.
secondary_routes.limitation: Cannot by itself distinguish odd versus even bilayer susceptibility; using it alone collapses to prior-art c-axis coherence.

secondary_routes.use: Allowed only if the Hamiltonian and bilayer form factors are fixed from normal-state structural/orbital data and validated by normal-state RIXS/neutron/Raman/optical spectra.
secondary_routes.limitation: If the theory fit is selected using superconducting pairing symmetry or output performance, it leaks and is invalid.

normal_state_packet.minimum_rows: At least 8 same-sample pressure or strain rows, and preferably 12-20, before any output labels are opened.

same_sample_data_status.basis: paper-search-mcp searches found component measurements and theory, but no single same-sample normal-state La3Ni2O7 dataset containing q_z-resolved chi_odd/chi_even, c-axis optical baselines, oxygen maps, strain/structure, dephasing, and dz2/ligand-hole proxies.

Fig. 2d: polarimetric RIXS at q=(0.035,0.035,2.727); separates magnetic from phonon leakage.
Fig. 4c-d: incident-energy and polarization dependence of the SDW peak; candidate dz2/interlayer orbital sensitivity proxy.

Supplementary Fig. S1: non-interacting even/odd static susceptibilities; use as model-dependence baseline.

covariance_annihilation_test.question: Can oxygen/strain/dephasing covariance annihilate the residual P_oe after conditioning?
covariance_annihilation_test.answer: Yes, with current or likely small-N data it can. A nonzero C_phi_ind survives only if P_oe retains cross-validated residual variance and rank discordance after oxygen vacancy, strain/phase fraction, scattering linewidth, c-axis spectral weight, Drude fraction, and dz2/ligand-hole proxies are measured on the same rows.
covariance_annihilation_test.baseline_vector: B_base = [z(W_c), z(f_D), z(gamma), z(V_O), z(epsilon_strain), z(Z_dz2), z(structural_phase_fraction)]
covariance_annihilation_test.annihilation_criterion: Declare baseline collapse if cross_validated_R2(P_oe ~ B_base) >= 0.85 and abs(mean(C_phi_ind))/sigma_P_oe <= 0.2 and no preregistered matched-pair rank inversion survives uncertainty.
covariance_annihilation_test.survival_criterion: Declare provisional survival only if cross_validated_R2 <= 0.65 or residual_rank_discordance is stable under leave-one-pressure-out, with abs(C_phi_ind) >= 2*sigma_residual for at least two matched pairs.
covariance_annihilation_test.realistic_small_N_warning: If N_pressure_rows <= 8 and B_base has six or more covariates, ordinary regression can overfit. Use shrinkage, leave-one-pressure-out prediction, and preregistered covariate blocks; otherwise apparent residuals are not credible.

case_annihilated.interpretation: Residual is comparable to measurement error; do not claim independent C_phi.

case_survives.interpretation: Residual is larger than error and may survive if matched-pair rank inversion is stable.

claims.statement: A leakage-free P_oe is definable only from normal-state odd/even bilayer spectral susceptibilities measured before superconducting output reveal.
assumptions: The measured spectral functions are positive and identically normalized.
The extraction uses only normal-state spectra.

claims.statement: The bilayer form-factor route provides an operational odd/even decomposition: I(q_z) can be fitted as chi_even*cos(q_z*d/2)**2 + chi_odd*sin(q_z*d/2)**2 plus background.

deepening.deepening_1_next_consequence: If P_oe survives baseline conditioning, C_phi is not a scalar interlayer metallicity; it is a layer-parity-selective response of the bilayer phase bus.
deepening.deepening_1_second_consequence: That would predict pressure or strain protocols that improve odd-channel phase readiness even when total c-axis spectral weight or Drude fraction is unchanged.
deepening.deepening_2_weak_premise: The weakest premise is that normal-state q_z/polarization spectroscopy can identify chi_odd and chi_even with enough precision under pressure.
deepening.deepening_2_second_consequence: If this premise fails, eta is not experimentally identifiable and C_phi collapses operationally even if a microscopic odd/even theory remains meaningful.
